trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: reach 100% completion. After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the in-game checklist — it only becomes viewable then, but progress you made during the story already counts. The checklist asks for the story missions, robberies (39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vault robberies), 100 optional tasks, collectibles (15 card sets, 100 WAiNK spots, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 Cocaine Flamingos), races, stunts, challenges and discoveries. PowerPyx notes the checklist is roughly 60% of true completion, so expect around 100 hours for this stage alone.
steps: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list top to bottom.
Do robberies and collectibles in free-roam; nothing on the list is missable.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in all. THIS IS THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, go to Jason's house in the morning and talk to Lucia in the kitchen: she says she is going to meditate, then heads to the balcony. Follow her and choose Accept. That balcony meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot, and guides disagree on whether it is required — do it anyway, to be safe. The last spot needs both characters and only opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Save manually at the start and end of every chapter, because missions cannot be replayed.
steps: Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: meditate with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2): meditate at the remaining spots.
